<template>
	<AsamButton type="primary" plain @click="open">点击打开消息框</AsamButton>
</template>

<script setup>
import { AsamButton, AsamMessage, AsamMessageBox } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue';
const open = () => {
	AsamMessageBox.prompt('请输入电子邮箱', '提示', {
		confirmButtonText: '确认',
		cancelButtonText: '取消',
		inputPattern:
			/[\w!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+(?:\.[\w!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+)*@(?:[\w](?:[\w-]*[\w])?\.)+[\w](?:[\w-]*[\w])?/,
		inputErrorMessage: '邮箱格式不正确'
	})
		.then(({ value }) => {
			trackAsamMessage(
				AsamMessage({
					type: 'success',
					message: `你的邮箱是：${value}`
				})
			);
		})
		.catch(() => {
			trackAsamMessage(
				AsamMessage({
					type: 'info',
					message: '已取消输入'
				})
			);
		});
};
const ownedAsamMessage = new Set();
let mountedAsamMessage = true;
const trackAsamMessage = (handle) => {
	if (mountedAsamMessage) ownedAsamMessage.add(handle);
	else handle.close();
	return handle;
};
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	mountedAsamMessage = false;
	for (const handle of ownedAsamMessage) handle.close();
	ownedAsamMessage.clear();
});
</script>
